title: Validate successful LTE Attach and Detach procedure for single UE under excellent radio conditions
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE in the cell
UE placed under excellent radio conditions as defined by LTE RSRP
Serving cell is activated and all other cells powered off
E2E setup operational for LTE
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the test configuration and record parameters in test report
Start log capture to record call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE and initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach confirmation (attach request and attach complete messages observed)
Verify UE is attached to the correct cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN in UE logs
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach confirmation (detach request and detach accept messages observed)
Stop and save the logs for reference
expectedResults: Attach procedure completes successfully with 100% success rate over 10 iterations
Detach procedure completes successfully with 100% success rate over 10 iterations
UE attached to correct cell parameters per test configuration
Attach latency measured and recorded (min, average, max) per iteration
Logs confirm expected signaling flow as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1
postconditions: Test logs saved for performance assessment
Attach and detach success rates recorded in KPI Table 5-2
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach and detach signaling messages
Verify RSRP values meet excellent radio condition thresholds
Check KPI values against expected success rates

title: Validate successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach procedure with Secondary Node Addition and Release for single UE under excellent radio conditions
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active UE
UE placed under excellent radio conditions as defined by 5G SS-RSRP
Serving cell activated with 5G NSA E2E setup operational
All other cells powered off
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to test configuration and record in test report
Start log capture to record call flow and signaling messages
Power ON UE and initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for successful attach including Secondary Node Addition (SgNB addition request and reconfiguration complete messages)
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN and NR-ARFCN in UE logs
Power OFF UE to initiate detach procedure including LTE detach and 5G Secondary Node Release
Wait for successful detach confirmation (detach request and accept, SgNB release request, and UE context release messages)
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure including Secondary Node Addition completes with 100% success rate over 10 iterations
Detach procedure including Secondary Node Release completes with 100% success rate over 10 iterations
UE attached to correct LTE and 5G cells per test configuration
Attach latency and Secondary Node Addition success rate recorded in KPI Table 5-2 and Table 5-3
Signaling flows validated as per 3GPP TS 23.401 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1 and 10.4.1
postconditions: Test logs saved for performance assessment
Attach, Secondary Node Addition, and Detach success rates recorded
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach, Secondary Node Addition, and detach signaling messages
Verify radio parameters RSRP and SS-RSRP meet excellent conditions
Check KPI values against expected targets

title: Validate LTE Attach procedure failure handling with poor radio conditions
preconditions: Single cell scenario with one active UE
UE placed under poor radio conditions below LTE RSRP threshold for excellent conditions
Serving cell activated
All other cells powered off
testSteps: Configure test setup with poor radio conditions
Start log capture
Power ON UE to initiate LTE attach
Wait and observe attach procedure outcome
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach failure observed due to poor radio conditions
Attach success rate below 100%
Attach latency increases or attach procedure times out
Logging shows attach request retries or failures
verificationMethods: Analyze attach failure messages in logs
Verify RSRP measurements confirm poor conditions
Check attach retry counts and error codes

title: Validate Secondary Node Release procedure initiated by Master Node (MN)
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with active MN and SN nodes
UE attached with active Secondary Node
Test environment supports signaling capture
testSteps: Ensure UE is attached and Secondary Node is active
MN initiates Secondary Node Release by sending SgNB Release Request message
Observe SN response with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message indicating UE to release SCG configuration
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report to MN
MN receives UE Context Release message and verifies SN resource release
Capture and save signaling logs
expectedResults: MN successfully initiates and completes Secondary Node Release
SN acknowledges release and releases UE context
UE releases SCG configuration upon RRCConnectionReconfiguration
Data forwarding and status reports exchanged as per procedure
Signaling flows match 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1 MN initiated flow
commandsUsed: Monitor MN and SN message exchanges
verificationMethods: Analyze captured signaling for SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge
Verify RRCConnectionReconfiguration message content
Confirm resource release messages and data forwarding coordination

title: Validate Secondary Node Release procedure initiated by Secondary Node (SN)
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with active MN and SN nodes
UE attached with active Secondary Node
Test environment supports signaling capture
testSteps: Ensure UE is attached and Secondary Node is active
SN initiates Secondary Node Release by sending SgNB Release Required message to MN
MN responds with SgNB Release Confirm message including data forwarding addresses if applicable
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE for SCG release
SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report to MN
MN receives UE Context Release message and SN releases UE context
Capture and save signaling logs
expectedResults: SN successfully initiates and completes Secondary Node Release
MN acknowledges and coordinates data forwarding
UE releases SCG configuration as instructed
Signaling flows per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1 SN initiated flow
Resources released and data forwarding handled correctly
commandsUsed: Monitor MN and SN message exchanges
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling messages for SgNB Release Required and Confirm
Verify RRCConnectionReconfiguration message content
Confirm release and data forwarding coordination

title: Validate attach and detach procedures repeatability over 10 iterations
preconditions: Single cell scenario with one active UE
UE placed under excellent radio conditions
Test environment configured for logging and KPI measurement
testSteps: Configure test setup and record parameters
For 10 iterations:
- Start logging
- Power ON UE to attach
- Wait for successful attach
- Power OFF UE to detach
- Wait for successful detach
- Stop logging and save data
Calculate attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, avg, max)
Record KPIs in test report tables
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures pass 10 consecutive times with 100% success
Attach latency within expected performance thresholds
No connectivity or signaling issues observed
KPI measurements consistent and accurate
verificationMethods: Aggregate logs for success/failure counts
Calculate latency metrics from timestamps
Verify KPI values against target thresholds

title: Validate attach procedure handling when UE is placed outside minimum coupling loss limits (too high attenuation)
preconditions: Single cell scenario with one active UE
UE placed under radio conditions exceeding minimum coupling loss (too weak signal)
Test environment supports log capture
testSteps: Configure radio link with attenuation to exceed minimum coupling loss
Start log capture
Power ON UE to initiate attach
Observe attach procedure behavior
Stop log capture and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or experiences significant latency
Attach success rate below 100%
Logs show attach request failures or retries
UE does not attach to serving cell
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach failure indications
Verify radio measurements confirm excessive attenuation
Confirm attach retry counts and error codes

title: Validate behavior when UE fails to comply with RRCConnectionReconfiguration during Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with active MN and SN
UE attached with Secondary Node
Test environment supports signaling capture
testSteps: MN initiates Secondary Node Release and sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE indicating SCG release
Simulate UE unable to comply with full reconfiguration (e.g., RRC failure)
Observe UE performing reconfiguration failure procedure
Capture signaling logs and UE behavior
expectedResults: UE triggers reconfiguration failure procedure as defined
MN and SN handle failure gracefully without resource leaks
Signaling messages reflect failure and recovery attempts
System maintains stable state post failure
postconditions: Logs saved for failure handling analysis
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for reconfiguration failure messages
Verify MN and SN correct handling of failure
Confirm UE state after failure

title: Validate data forwarding coordination between MN and SN during Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with active MN and SN supporting data forwarding
UE attached with active Secondary Node
Test environment supports signaling and data flow capture
testSteps: MN initiates Secondary Node Release and provides data forwarding addresses to SN
SN confirms release and starts data forwarding to MN
Verify timing coordination between SN sending Secondary RAT Data Usage Report and data forwarding start
Capture and analyze signaling and data flow logs
Repeat procedure with SN initiated release
expectedResults: Data forwarding starts timely minimizing service gaps
Secondary RAT Data Usage Report sent appropriately without waiting for data forwarding to complete
No data loss or service interruption observed
Signaling and data flows conform to 3GPP Clause 10.4.1
postconditions: Logs saved for performance and correctness validation
verificationMethods: Analyze timing of signaling messages related to data forwarding
Verify data continuity and usage reports
Confirm no service gaps during release

title: Validate security aspects during attach/detach procedures (authentication and authorization)
preconditions: Test environment supports monitoring of authentication and authorization messages
UE and network configured with valid security credentials
testSteps: Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure
Monitor signaling messages for authentication requests and responses
Verify authorization procedures are correctly enforced
Power OFF UE to initiate detach procedure
Monitor any security-related signaling during detach
Attempt attach with invalid credentials and observe rejection
expectedResults: Authentication and authorization messages exchanged correctly during attach
Unauthorized access attempts rejected by network
Detach procedure does not compromise security
No security breaches or unauthorized attach accepted
verificationMethods: Analyze authentication and authorization message flows
Verify rejection messages for invalid attach attempts
Confirm security compliance in attach/detach procedures
